description:
Tomark - The Ultimate Watermark Maker

Easily watermark your photos and videos with Tomark, a professional watermarking app designed to protect your content and build your brand. With fully customizable templates, you can add text, logos, or unique designs to your media in just a few clicks. Protect your visuals or mark them with your personal or business brand using Tomark simple, step-by-step process.

Key Features:

- Create & Save Custom Watermarks
Design your own watermark and save it for future use. Choose from our ready-made templates or upload your own logo to personalize every photo or video with your brand.

- Complete Control & Preview
Preview your watermark and adjust its placement, transparency, color, and size for each photo or video. Customize every aspect to ensure your watermark is exactly where and how you want it.

- Text-Based Watermarks
Create custom text watermarks in seconds. Add your name, brand tagline, or any other text. Edit colors, fonts, sizes, opacity, rotation, and background to make it yours.

- Watermark Patterns
Choose from various watermark patterns to style your watermark. You can even tile or cross-pattern your watermark across the whole image for optimal protection and branding.

- Add Your Logo or Signature
Add a digital signature or your company’s logo to reinforce your brand identity. Import images to create unique watermarks that add a professional touch to every piece of content.

- Copyright Symbols
Enhance your watermark with copyright, trademark, or registered symbols to protect your images and videos from unauthorized use.

- Pixel-Perfect Positioning
Achieve precision placement with Tomark’s alignment tools. Your watermark stays consistently positioned on every photo or video processed in the batch.

- Wide Font Collection
Select from an extensive library of fonts to make your watermark unique. From classic fonts to stylish and modern options, Tomark has something for every brand.

- Cross and Tiling Options
Opt for a cross or tiled watermark pattern for maximum security. Your watermark can span the entire image, making it difficult to remove or crop.

Why Use Tomark?

Protect Your Content:
Prevent unauthorized use by adding an easy yet secure watermark on all your photos and videos.

Build Brand Awareness:
Make your photos instantly recognizable by adding your logo or digital signature. Great for personal branding and business use.

Connect with Potential Customers:
Add your website, email, or social media handle to your watermark to make it easy for viewers to reach out to you.

Professional-Looking Content:
Whether you’re creating watermarks for social media, marketing, or personal projects, Tomark gives you the tools for a polished result every time.

Start protecting your content and building your brand today with Tomark!
